# upload_game_files

[← Command index](README.md)

Encrypt game folders in place and upload them to a remote locker.

## Synopsis

```
upload_game_files [options]
```

## Description

For each selected game, works on its folder in the source locker
(`Gaming/<supercategory>/<category>/<subcategory>/<game>`) or on `-i`:

1. Encrypts every file in the folder with GPG (AES-256) using the destination
   locker's passphrase. Each file becomes `<md5 of name>.enc` with its real name stored
   inside, and the unencrypted original is deleted.
2. Records each file's real name, XXH3 hash and size, plus the encrypted file's name,
   MD5 and size, in the game hash metadata (`Hashes/<supercategory>/<category>/
   <subcategory>.json` under the configured game metadata directory).
3. Copies the encrypted folder to the same path, relative to the local locker, on the
   destination locker.

In `Standard` mode the games are the folders found in the source locker, narrowed by
`-u`, `-c`, `-s` and `-n` (an exact folder name). In `Custom` mode `-c`, `-s` and `-n`
are required and name exactly one game.

## Options

### Game selection

| Option | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `-i, --input_path <input_path>` | Game folder to encrypt and upload instead of the one derived from the game options. |
| `-u, --game_supercategory <game_supercategory>` | Supercategory of the games to upload. Default: `Roms`. Allowed: `Assets`, `Emulators`, `Roms`, `DLC`, `Updates`, `Tags`, `Saves`, `Setup`, `Installs`. |
| `-c, --game_category <game_category>` | Category of the games to upload; all categories when omitted in `Standard` mode. Allowed: `Computer`, `Microsoft`, `Nintendo`, `Other`, `Sony`. |
| `-s, --game_subcategory <game_subcategory>` | Subcategory (platform) of the games to upload; all of the category's subcategories when omitted in `Standard` mode. PlayStation 3`, `Sony PlayStation Network - PlayStation 4`, `Sony PlayStation Network - PlayStation Portable`, `Sony PlayStation Network - PlayStation Portable Minis`, `Sony PlayStation Network - PlayStation Vita`, `Sony PlayStation Portable`, `Sony PlayStation Portable Video`, `Sony PlayStation Vita`. |
| `-n, --game_name <game_name>` | Exact name of the game folder to upload; every game found when omitted in `Standard` mode. |

### Lockers

| Option | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `-l, --source_locker <source_locker>` | Locker whose game folders are selected and encrypted. Default: `Local`. Allowed: `All`, `Local`, `Hetzner`, `Gdrive`, `External`. |
| `-m, --generation_mode <Custom\|Standard>` | `Standard` finds games in the source locker; `Custom` takes exactly the game named by `-c`, `-s` and `-n`. Default: `Standard`. Allowed: `Custom`, `Standard`. |
| `-d, --dest_locker <dest_locker>` | Locker to upload to; its passphrase encrypts the files. Allowed: `All`, `Local`, `Hetzner`, `Gdrive`, `External`. |

### Common options

| Option | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `-v, --verbose` | Enable verbose mode. |
| `-p, --pretend_run` | Do a pretend run with no permanent changes. |
| `-x, --exit_on_failure` | Enable exit on failure mode. |
| `--no-preview` | Skip the preview confirmation prompt. |

## Examples

### Encrypt and upload one Nintendo Switch game to Hetzner

```bash
upload_game_files -c Nintendo -s "Nintendo Switch" -n "Game Name" -d Hetzner
```

### Show what would be encrypted and uploaded without changing anything

```bash
upload_game_files -c Nintendo -s "Nintendo Switch" -n "Game Name" -d Hetzner -p -v
```

### Upload a Steam game

```bash
upload_game_files -c Computer -s Steam -n "Game Name" -d Hetzner
```

### Upload a game's DLC

```bash
upload_game_files -u DLC -c Nintendo -s "Nintendo Switch" -n "Game Name" -d Hetzner
```

### Upload every Nintendo Switch game in the local locker

```bash
upload_game_files -c Nintendo -s "Nintendo Switch" -d Hetzner
```

### Upload one game from a folder of your choosing

```bash
upload_game_files -m Custom -i /path/to/game/files -c Nintendo -s "Nintendo Switch" -n "Game Name" -d Hetzner
```

## Notes

- The local copies are left encrypted: the unencrypted originals are deleted. Decrypt them with `crypt_tool -d -t Locker` or copy them out decrypted with `backup_tool -r Decrypt`.
- Files that are already `.enc` are left as they are, so an interrupted run can be repeated.
- `-i` is used for every selected game, so give it only with `-m Custom` or a `-n` that matches one game.
- The first game that fails stops the run.
